title: Silent Unoxidized Copper Chests
description: Mutes Normal Copper Chests and Waxed Copper Chests
body:
Have you ever found annoying the constant opening/closing sound that copper golems make with opening the copper chests all the time? This Resource Pack Fixes that by disabling the sounds of Normal And Normal Waxed Copper Chests


**This Resource Pack Contains Repurposed Content From a Resource Pack Named "Chest and Copper Golem Mute" by torbftw (https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chest-and-copper-golem-mute)**
